title: How a Godly Man Spends His Single Years Without Waiting on a Wife
caption:
Single years aren't a waiting room. They're where a man gets built.

Four things a godly man does with them: settles who chose him first, fixes what a wife would inherit, lets brothers see her before he does, and says no to the almost.

Which one are you avoiding?

#faith #godlymen #christianman #singleseason #discipline #brotherhood
theme: He chases God, not a wife.
